kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Working band Rs 259-272 (single aggregator, unconfirmed; RHP prints [●]); pre-IPO placement at Rs 272.07 (p. 123). At Rs 272: 16.32 crore post-offer shares, market cap Rs 4,438 cr; P/E 30.5x FY26 PAT to owners (27.1x adjusted for the CCD fair-value loss and exceptional item); company's own P/E 23.8x basic / 24.6x diluted; P/B 2.06x post-offer; EV/EBITDA 9.6x FY26 adjusted EBITDA.

focus.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
focus.detail: Other intangibles Rs 782.10 cr at Mar-26 (Rs 370.75 cr Mar-24) from acquired brands (Rs 483.46 cr asset purchase and Rs 242.98 cr I&B Seeds business in FY25, p. 104); amortised over 5-10 years: Rs 142.73 cr in FY26 (p. 508), about equal to PAT. Goodwill Rs 25.73 cr.

focus.title: Contingent liabilities
focus.detail: Contingent liabilities Rs 113.27 cr at Jun-26 (entry tax Rs 69.20 cr, GST Rs 33.35 cr), 5.8% of equity. Litigation against the company Rs 255.94 cr (11.77% of net worth), including 85 criminal cases (mostly Insecticides Act sampling matters typical of agrochemicals).
